description: This Scala source file defines an abstract class 'StructFilters' and related objects for applying and managing pushed-down filters on internal data rows within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst module. It includes methods for converting filters to expressions, filtering rows, and handling schema references.

classes.name: StructFilters
classes.description: An abstract class providing API for applying pushed-down filters to internal rows based on a schema.

classes.name: NoopFilters
classes.description: A concrete implementation of StructFilters that performs no filtering.

methods.name: skipRow
methods.description: Determines if a row can be skipped based on filters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of filters before processing a new row.

methods.name: toPredicate
methods.description: Converts a sequence of filters into a predicate object.

methods.name: toRef
methods.description: Finds a schema field index and converts it to a BoundReference.

methods.name: checkFilterRefs
methods.description: Checks if filter references are within the schema field names.

methods.name: pushedFilters
methods.description: Filters supported by the datasource after pushdown.

methods.name: zip
methods.description: Zips two optional values into an optional pair.

methods.name: toLiteral
methods.description: Converts a value to a Literal expression.

methods.name: filterToExpression
methods.description: Converts a filter to an expression with bound references.
